response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile full-stack engineer with 15+ years of experience, but the profile is heavily oriented toward web development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than the deep C++ expertise this role demands. C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a bachelor thesis project, with no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL practices, MQTT, industrial protocols, or Azure. The mismatch on core competencies outweighs the transferable systems-programming background.
strengths: Solid systems-programming fundamentals from low-latency, high-throughput microservices work (async I/O, caching, fibers) at Dunnhumby
Experience with event-driven architectures and distributed platforms (GISCollective, Kubernetes deployments)
Strong engineering culture: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months, a decade ago); primary languages are TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
No exposure to industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443), SDL practices, MQTT, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
Career trajectory centers on web/SaaS products, not automation machinery or on-prem industrial platforms

key_factors.factor: Transferable low-latency and event-driven systems experience
